d: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has defended Washington's blockade of Iran, declaring that Iranian oil will not get out through the Strait of Hormuz. Rubio said the economic pressure and sanctions are devastating Iran's economy, insisting that President Donald Trump has no need to resume major combat operations. He warned that Tehran would face consequences if it escalates military action. Rubio also said Washington remains open to a deal but rejected what he called absurd Iranian conditions.
